bibliography.title: Enhanced Proton Conductivity by the Influence of Modified  Montmorillonite on Poly (Vinyl alcohol) Based Blend  Composite Membranes

mechanism_relevant_findings: The highest proton conductivity value of 0.0802 Scm -1 is obtained at 6wt% of protonated MMT added to the PVA/PEG blends.
Significant improvements in hydrolytic stability were observed in the composite membranes.

numerical_findings.conditions: 6wt% of protonated MMT in PVA/PEG blends

eis_shape_findings: Proton conductivity measurements were made via Nyquist plot.

relevance_judgement.reason: The study provides significant insights into proton transport mechanisms in composite membranes.
